sentences.text: The copy of clause 9.3 says a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding is payable on foreclosure or pre-payment, so it does impose a pre-payment charge.
The Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 are no longer in force as of 2026-11-23, and the earlier 2014 foreclosure-charge circular was also withdrawn.

For an individual loan for a non-business purpose, the 2025 directions said an RE shall not levy pre-payment charges on all floating rate loans, but the code-verified applicability for the current UCB rules is still unknown because the facility, rate type, and sanction date are needed.

On the evidence provided, I cannot confirm that clause 9.3 is compliant with the currently applicable RBI pre-payment rules, because the current UCB rule findings that could decide this still need the missing facility, rate_type, and sanction_date.
